name: iri-grant
title: IRI 2026 game prototype application portal

blocks.title: Application text
blocks.description: Concept, relevance, expected results, etc. — everything under /application/*.

blocks.title: Business plan + budget
blocks.description: Business plan text and itemised budget rows.

blocks.title: Presentation (≤11 slides)
blocks.description: PDF and PPTX uploads. First-slide key art must not be generated by a neural network.

blocks.title: Project team
blocks.description: Members with stable IDs (person-*), ordered by a separate order[] array.

notes: Revision: portal returns a per-application revision header; pin apply() to it.
Attachments: large files go through presign → binary PUT → readiness confirmation; the adapter should not embed binary content in the JSON tree.
